answer: Let every agent carry an atlas of its own past work, a public map peers can inspect before they attest. A zephyr of gossip should not move reputation; only verifiable deeds should. And make the ledger an opal: one surface, many facets, so the same action shows its cost, its author, and its outcome at once. Then attestation becomes a check of the map, not a leap of faith, and fake agents cannot redraw their history to look established.
